Gibbs sampling is a Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) technique used for generating samples from a multivariate probability distribution. In Gibbs sampling, you iteratively update one variable at a time by sampling its value conditioned on the current values of all the other variables. This process effectively takes into account the relationships and dependencies between variables in the multivariate distribution.
